evidence: REAL MINECRAFT NATURAL RESOURCE TASK; NOT FULL SURVIVAL COMPLETION
time_semantics: seconds measures task time after viewer readiness; elapsed_wall_seconds also includes world startup and viewer join
state_note: Compact partial observation; not a complete Minecraft MDP state
scripted_support: Feasibility masks; bounded pathfinding, digging, pickup, recipes, placement, equip; bounded leaf clearing inside SEARCH (canopy descent beneath the feet, foliage escape beside the bot); spectator camera only
recovery_helpers: When the bot stands on tree leaves, SEARCH may clear at most six leaf blocks directly beneath its feet, one at a time, only after scanning the column below for a landing within a recorded safe fall (no damage, or at most two points while health stays above ten, measured to the landing block's collision surface). Each cleared block, fall, and health change is saved in the transition's recovery field. Leaves broken by hand follow the vanilla loot table (about 5% sapling, 2% one or two sticks, 0.5% apple on oak and dark oak); pickups collected during a descent or an escape are listed in that record as items_picked_up and count in the inventory like any other natural item. When the bridge's movement rules report no legal move from the current cell, SEARCH may clear at most two leaf blocks beside the bot (feet and head height) towards a floored exit; never a log, dirt, or stone; recorded as leaf_escape (alone, or as the escape field of the descent record that led to it). Apart from these leaf blocks, no block is dug outside CHOP
reset: Each episode generates a separate new normal Survival world; bot has no operator permissions
seed_note: World seed controls terrain; server timing and spawn selection are not deterministic
